kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعصوصب (form XII)
# أَعْصَوْصِبُ (ʔaʕṣawṣibu) /ʔaʕ.sˤaw.sˤi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
# أَعْصَوْصِبَ (ʔaʕṣawṣiba) /ʔaʕ.sˤaw.sˤi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
# أَعْصَوْصِبْ (ʔaʕṣawṣib) /ʔaʕ.sˤaw.sˤib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِعْصَوْصَبَ (iʕṣawṣaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
